_comment: Ground-truth boxes for the camera/*.jpg frames in this session, [x0,y0,x1,y1] as fractions of the 320x320 camera square, or null for no chocolate present (same format as training-photos/boxes.json). NOT the finder's own output, which is wrong here - that is the whole point of this session. RE-MEASURED 12 Nov 2026, before any new finder was scored against them (originals kept in experiments/finder-truth-before-2026-11-12/test-11.json): the original hand-drawn boxes were roughly twice the chocolate's size in four of the five frames, which at this distance meant a PERFECTLY placed box would score around 20-25% overlap - below the 30% that training/lib/finder_eval.js counts as a hit. Each was re-measured automatically from the photo (the darkest connected blob inside the old box, or the yellowest for zwhite, the same method for every frame in test-9/10/11) and checked by eye on a zoomed coordinate grid. Original values: zmilk/scan1 [0.419,0.609,0.509,0.697], zwhite/scan2 [0.434,0.590,0.492,0.648], zdark/scan3 [0.391,0.555,0.461,0.617], 0/scan4 [0.418,0.605,0.500,0.680], 10/scan5 [0.379,0.574,0.461,0.625].
